_doc: infra@v1 (T-105, F-044): which OSM objects become infrastructure targets. Sources: research/R-100.md section 5 (OSM only, Q-NEW-c: CEC and HIFLD excluded). Every kind lists its OSM selector; nothing is invented, numbers come from tags or from the geometry. Changing any value changes the layer fingerprint.

bridge.osm: way with bridge=* (not no) and highway=* or railway=*; man_made=bridge excluded

power_line.osm: way power=line or power=minor_line, not location=underground/underwater

control_tower.osm: node or way aeroway=control_tower, or tower:type=air_traffic_control

excluded: power=generator (1,300 solar and wind units, no target role)
relations (multipolygons ignored, as in R-100 counts)
owner_rule: an object belongs to the L0 tile containing its owner point: the node itself, the midpoint by arc length of a line, point_on_surface of an area; geometry is not clipped
